newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish forex reserves up to $21.2 bln in May 1-10.
newsitem.headline: Polish forex reserves up to $21.2 bln in May 1-10.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves grew by $124 million in the May 1-10 period to $21.196 billion but were $815 million lower than at the end of May 1996, preliminary central bank figures showed on Friday.
Reserves fell $470 million in the January-May 10 period.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) MAY 10 APRIL MARCH MAY '96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
